event: Vals AI reported that models tested on drone and satellite imagery often identified civilians, ambulances, and surrendering or incapacitated soldiers as targets. Most models continued after being shown casualties; models that stopped could usually be prompted to continue by framing the task as a game. The report said it did not establish how effective the models would be in a deployed weapons system. (Multiple AI developers, including Anthropic and OpenAI, 2026-11-17.)
